name: Hazza'rah the Dreamweaver
notes: Numbers follow the Hazza'rah section of docs/research/zul-gurub/edge-of-madness.md: 266,500 HP (Era), 5,240 mana, level 63, 20-man, no real adds except the Illusions. No cadences are published: Sleep, Illusions and Earth Shock intervals here are estimates. Boss melee (300 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and dies if the healer ignores a spike. The fight's central job in the real raid is draining his 5,240 mana to zero so Chain Burn stops (Viper Sting, Drain Mana); the engine has no mana, so this cannot be modelled and Chain Burn is left out entirely. A raid that did not drain him would suffer far more than this script shows. Mass Sleep is a 6 s `debuff` (stun) on non-tanks; damage waking you early is not modelled, nor Tremor Totem or Divine Shield breaking it, and the tank is not put to sleep because the real tank is woken instantly by the next hit (and the sim has one tank player). HoTs on the tank before each sleep cannot be expressed; the healer simply has to heal ahead of time. Illusions: three `adds` per wave, killFirst, with a high per-attack damage to stand in for the one-global kills of the real 458 HP, fixed-target adds; their fixation on a raid member and their 5,000 hits are not modelled. Earth Shock is a one-tick debuff on the tank (1,094 Nature). There is no Silence on the shock (it interrupts casters) because the engine has no spell-school locks.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him in the middle. Mass Sleep puts everyone but you down for 6 s: keep yourself alive on the healing already landed, and do not move him.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay on him and swing at the Illusions the moment they appear: they die in one or two hits and hit like trucks.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: You are the Illusion killers. The instant three appear, turn and kill each in a global. Then back to him. Stop when the bar goes red.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Heal ahead of every Mass Sleep: you will be out for 6 s and so will every other healer. Keep the tank above the danger line going into each one.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

massSleep.label: Mass Sleep
massSleep.tip: Everyone in range falls asleep for 6 s. Only damage wakes you. Healers: heal ahead of this.

illusions.label: Nightmare Illusions
illusions.tip: Three illusions appear and each one goes for a raid member. 458 HP and immune to AoE: one Multi-Shot or Fire Blast each. They hit for 5,000.

expectations.label: Pull him to his spot
expectations.tip: Taunt him and hold him in the middle of the clearing.

expectations.label: Kill the Illusions first
expectations.tip: Each one hits for 5,000. Three seconds on one is someone dead.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank up ahead of each sleep
expectations.tip: You will sleep for 6 s. Have the tank topped before it lands.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: The sleep is your enemy. Everyone is out for 6 s.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Do not let the tank sit low going into a sleep.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

cues.notes: Heal the tank and do not get caught by Mass Sleep.

list.label: Taunt when Hazza'rah turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

drills.name: Hold him
drills.description: Pull him and hold him at the spot through Earth Shocks.

drills.name: Illusion kills
drills.description: Three illusions every 14 s. Face each one and kill it, then go back to him.

drills.name: Pre-heal the sleep
drills.description: A sleep every 18 s. Top the tank up before each one so they live 6 s without you.
